title_zh: 周报 | 量子计算史上最大收购，IonQ斥资18亿美元吞下SkyWater；工信部成立「量子信息标委会」…
text_zh:
IonQ
获得监管批准，完成对
SkyWater
Technology
的收购
7月28日，IonQ宣布已获得最终监管批准收购SkyWater Technology，使两家公司有望于2026年7月31日完成交易，总交易价值约18亿美元，并加强IonQ在美国的量子计算制造能力。此次收购旨在加快IonQ的量子计算路线图，确保建立一个完全国内化、可扩展的半导体供应链，以支持其以芯片为核心的硬件战略。SkyWater关闭后，将继续以全资子公司身份以现有名称运营，同时服务铸造厂客户，合并后公司计划于2026年8月5日举行第二季度财报电话会议，9月8日举行投资者日。
来源：
https://www.ionq.com/news/ionq-receives-regulatory-approval-to-complete-acquisition-of-skywater-technology
工业和信息化部量子信息标准化技术委员会成立
7月30日，工业和信息化部量子信息标准化技术委员会成立大会在北京召开。工业和信息化部党组成员、副部长柯吉欣出席会议并讲话。工业和信息化部有关司局负责同志，量子信息标委会委员代表、相关行业专家等参加会议。量子信息标委会主要负责量子信息基础共性技术、量子计算、量子通信、量子精密测量等领域行业标准制修订工作，秘书处设在中国信息通信研究院。
来源：
https://www.miit.gov.cn/xwfb/bldhd/art/2026/art_79e6b8bde1974fc9b120b0e18cb0b262.html
美国参议员提出《国家量子准备法案》，通过量子技术加强国家安全和创新
7月28日，美国参议员迈克·朗兹和理查德·布卢门撒尔提出《国家量子准备法案》，该立法指示战争部支持量子技术的发展并促进私营部门创新。该提案要求五角大楼在60天内指定三个优先量子传感器项目，并于2028年9月30日前部署。同时，提案中还呼吁与相关机构及私营企业共同制定相关计划。各方关注的一个焦点是量子后密码学技术的可能加速应用及其对加密安全的影响。
来源：
https://www.rounds.senate.gov/newsroom/press-releases/rounds-introduces-legislation-to-bolster-national-security-and-innovation-through-quantum-technologies
匹兹堡超级计算中心
获
500
万美元资助，
用于
建造新的混合量子
-
经典超级计算机
7月27日，匹兹堡超级计算中心获得了美国国家科学基金会500万美元的资助，用于建设TangleLab——一个与HPE和Rigetti Computing合作的混合量子-经典超级计算测试平台，预计2027年开始运营。TangleLab将整合
Rigetti Novera™
量子处理单元与
HPE高性能计算、存储和网络系统，支持对混合量子-经典工作流、人工智能、仿真和量子计算应用的研究。该系统将为研究人员、教育者和学生提供竞争性访问、培训和技术支持，推动量子计算研究和劳动力发展，同时成为未来混合网络基础设施的原型。
来源：
https://www.psc.edu/psc-will-build-new-hybrid-quantum-classical-supercomputer/
AT&T
扩大与
D-Wave
合作，探索量子计算技术在网络运营中的应用
7月27日，D-Wave与AT&T签署协议，扩大D-Wave量子计算技术在网络优化应用中的应用。AT&T采用了D-Wave的退火量子计算技术，优化工作负载将处理时间从约一小时缩短到不到15秒。公司计划探索更多应用，包括停电响应、技术人员路由、网络规划、流量管理以及潜在的量子安全应用场景。
来源：
https://www.dwavequantum.com/company/newsroom/press-release/at-t-signs-agreement-to-expand-use-of-d-wave-s-quantum-computing-technology/
QTREX
与东北大学合作，启动量子互联研究项目
7月27日，QTREX宣布与东北大学开展研究合作，开发用于量子计算基础设施的先进低温量子互联技术。该合作将研究低温量子环境的微系统结构、互连设计以及适用于低温量子环境的材料，同时还将生成实验数据，为未来的连接解决方案提供依据。根据协议，QTREX将获得首次谈判权，以协商通过联合研究产生的知识产权的商业许可。
来源：
https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/27/3333405/0/en/QTREX-Launches-Quantum-Interconnect-Research-Program-with-Commercialization-Rights-to-Project-Generated-IP.html
Multiverse Computing
宣布
5.7
亿美元
C
轮融资，加速
CompactifAI
部署
7月27日，Multiverse Computing已筹集了一轮5.7亿美元的C轮融资，估值为17亿美元，旨在加速其AI模型压缩平台CompactifAI的部署，并在全球范围内扩展高效的AI基础设施。该公司的CompactifAI技术应用源自量子物理的张量网络方法，将大型语言模型压缩80%至95%，精度损失极小，实现更快、低功耗的AI部署，覆盖云端、本地端和边缘设备。资金将支持研发、主权人工智能基础设施、向关键国际市场的扩展，以及在制造业、金融、能源、航空航天、网络安全、国防和医疗等多个行业的部署规模化。
来源：
https://multiversecomputing.com/resources/multiverse-computing-announces-series-c-fundraising-targeting-up-to-usd570m-eur500m-to-power
Two Hands Corporation
开放
EntangleX
量子电路模拟器外部测试
7月28日，Two Hands公司已在完成内部测试后，向部分合作伙伴开放了其量子电路仿真软件平台EntangleX的外部测试阶段。测试版将收集关于平台用户界面、电路构建工作流程、稳定性和功能的反馈，以指导未来的开发。EntangleX是一款基于软件的量子电路模拟器，利用传统计算基础设施来模拟量子电路，而非在物理量子硬件上运行。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/two-hands-corporation-announces-new-entanglex-milestone-as-external-partner-beta-testing-begins-302836675.html
Riverlane
与
Unitary
基金会启动“
Deltakit
社区基金”，加速开源量子
纠错
7月28日，Riverlane和Unitary基金会宣布启动Deltakit社区基金，支持外部开发者为Riverlane的开源量子纠错工具包开发功能。该季度项目将为专注于错误预算、阈值计算和基准测试工具等领域的开发者提供2000至4000美元的开发者奖金。该倡议基于Unitary基金会的unitaryHACK26参与，旨在为开源量子软件开发创建一个结构化的贡献管道。
来源：
https://www.riverlane.com/press-release/riverlane-and-unitary-foundation-launch-deltakit-community-fund
四家量子公司加入新墨西哥州开放访问量子网络，用于开发和验证下一代安全技术
7月28日，
Infleqtion、Aliro、Tensora和Bandelier Technologies
四家量子公司
加入新墨西哥州的
ABQ-Net，一个基于开放接入的基于纠缠的量子网络，总部位于美国，负责开发和验证量子网络、传感、定时和安全技术。ABQ-Net由Qunnect通过Roadrunner Venture Studios创建，并得到新墨西哥州技术与创新办公室的支持，为企业提供实时量子网络测试平台，无需建设专业基础设施，这是该州超过4.5亿美元量子开发投资的一部分。
来源：
https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/four-leading-quantum-companies-sign-on-to-abq-net-the-first-open-access-quantum-network-in-the-united-states-302835757.html
ZuriQ
筹集
2550
万美元种子资金，用于扩展开创性的
2D
量子架构
7月28日，ZuriQ是一家瑞士量子计算公司，从苏黎世联邦理工学院分拆出来，宣布已筹集到2550万美元的种子资金，用于扩展其离子阱量子处理器的规模化。本轮融资基于公司2025年420万美元的预种子轮，由Quantonation主导，Forward.one、Extantia、Firgun Ventures及所有以往轮投资者参与。ZuriQ将利用新资本扩充团队，同时推进研发工作，显著提升其架构支持量子比特数量。
来源：
https://zuriq.com/fundraise/zuriq-raises-25-5-million/
Anthropic
表示，人工智能发现加密算法的新弱点
7月28日，Anthropic表示，其Claude Mythos预览AI模型发现了针对HAWK后量子数字签名候选和缩减轮数AES的更优数学攻击，证明先进AI可以在不影响现有生产系统的情况下为密码学研究做出贡献。该人工智能通过识别出此前未知的数学对称性，降低了HAWK的有效安全余地，并开发出一种新攻击，其速度是研究版七轮AES的200至800倍，研究人员则花费数周验证模型结果。Anthropic表示，这些结果凸显了AI在评估加密算法部署前日益重要的作用，促使公司发布新的研究论文和CryptanalysisBench，帮助研究人员衡量AI在密码分析中的能力。
来源：
https://www.anthropic.com/research/discovering-cryptographic-weaknesses
EY
宣布引入现场量子计算，支持量子应用开发与测试
7月29日，EY正在扩展其全球量子计算能力，新增一台现场量子计算机，作为对人工智能及其他新兴技术投资超过30亿美元的一部分。新基础设施旨在支持安全的量子应用开发与测试，适用于优化、欺诈检测、数据保护和大规模风险管理等用例。公司表示，此次投资增强了其在内部及客户范围内开发、验证和部署量子解决方案的能力，同时推动数据治理、安全和量子准备度。
来源：
https://www.ey.com/en_gl/newsroom/2026/07/ey-announces-on-site-quantum-computing-to-help-shape-the-next-frontier-of-enterprise-technology-transformation
IQM
在完成
ESOP1
认购后，注册
183619
股新股
7月29日，IQM Quantum Computers在其完成与RAAQ业务合并后，注册了183619股新股，已通过其ESOP 1员工股票期权计划认购。新股份于2026年7月29日在芬兰商业登记处注册，使IQM的股份和投票总数达到2.6322万3216亿。新发行的股票将于2026年7月30日前后与现有股票一同开始在纳斯达克赫尔辛基交易。
来源：
https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/29/3334985/0/en/iqm-quantum-computers-plc-s-new-shares-subscribed-for-under-esop-1-have-been-registered-with-the-finnish-trade-register.html
Horizon Quantum
宣布与
Quantum Machines
合作，提升量子系统效率
7月29日，Horizon Quantum与Quantum Machine宣布合作，开发用于Horizon Quantum的Ember-1超导量子计算机测试平台的嵌入式校准技术。两家公司将利用Quantum Machines的OPX1000控制系统和编排平台，创建旨在提升系统正常运行时间和运行稳定性的校准程序。该合作旨在通过实现量子系统运行期间更频繁的参数更新，减少对长周期校准周期的依赖。
来源：
https://www.horizonquantum.com/resources/newsroom/horizon-quantum-and-quantum-machines-announce-strategic-collaboration-to-increase-efficiency-of-quantum-systems
GlobalFoundries
与美国商务部签署意向书，获得
3
亿美元资助
7月29日，GlobalFoundries宣布已与美国商务部签署意向书，拟获得潜在3亿美元的CHIPS研发项目，以推动硅光子技术和先进封装的发展。资金将支持近封装光学及协封光学的光学材料、晶圆技术及制造能力的开发，这些光学器件用于人工智能和高性能计算系统。GlobalFoundries将基于其硅光子平台和SCALE™技术，扩展美国本土下一代光互连的生产能力。
来源：
https://gf.com/news-and-events/news/globalfoundries-signs-letter-of-intent-with-the-us-department-of-commerce-for-a-300-million-award-to-accelerate-us-silicon-photonics-leadership/
中科酷原与武汉量子院合作，共建湖北首个量子领域研企联合攻关平台
7月29日，中科酷原科技（武汉）有限公司与武汉量子技术研究院签约，双方将共建量子计算与精密测量联合开发实验室。根据协议，双方将围绕量子计算、量子精密测量等方向，共同建设量子计算与精密测量联合开发实验室，围绕量子测控系统优化、量子精密测量工程化应用、量子计算云平台商业化迭代、核心器件国产化适配等方向开展联合攻关，并建立成果转化、人才培养等长效合作机制。这是湖北省首个量子领域研企联合攻关平台，标志着湖北量子产业加速从单点突破迈向协同创新。
来源：
https://www.hubei.gov.cn/hbfb/rdgz/202607/t20260730_5985891.shtml
量旋科技与深创生物达成战略合作，以量子计算赋能创新药物研发
7月29日，深圳量旋科技股份有限公司（“量旋科技”）与深圳深创生物药业有限公司（“深创生物”）正式签署框架合作协议，达成战略合作。双方将以“量子计算赋能药物研发”为核心方向，建立长期稳定、互利共赢的合作伙伴关系，充分发挥各自在量子计算与生物医药研发领域的优势，共同探索量子计算技术在创新药研发及成果转化中的应用路径，推动前沿计算技术与生物医药领域协同创新。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/th1CTeHgQevG4vn4Lq8s8A
IBM
和
Qedma
宣布实现突破性研究，展示超越经典基准的误差缓解量子仿真
7月30日，IBM和Qedma展示了利用IBM Quantum Heron处理器和Qedma的QESEM软件进行的误差缓解量子计算工作流程，研究一个74量子比特的物理模型。该研究将量子结果与经典仿真方法（包括富岳超级计算机上的模拟）进行了比较，发现量子结果在经典方法不一致的范围内是一致的。此次合作利用跨量子平台的验证技术，展示了科学应用中可信量子计算的框架。
来源：
https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-07-30-ibm-and-qedma-demonstrate-quantum-advantage,-modeling-physics-beyond-classical-capabilities-through-trusted-quantum-computation
IBM
与
Algorithmiq
开发框架，用于验证超越经典模拟的量子计算
7月30日，IBM和Algorithmiq展示了一种量子计算框架，用于研究异构量子材料，同时在经典验证方法不可用时验证结果。团队使用IBM Quantum Heron处理器模拟可编程量子材料，并基于噪声建模、误差缓解和跨平台测试开发了验证方法。Algorithmiq发布了单螺旋桨经典仿真软件包，使研究人员能够独立评估未来的量子优势主张。
来源：
https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-07-30-ibm-and-algorithmiq-demonstrate-quantum-advantage,-establishing-a-framework-for-trusted-quantum-computation-beyond-classical-verification
IBM
和芝加哥大学展示量子优势，建立逻辑电路上的可信量子计算
7月30日，IBM与芝加哥大学的研究人员宣布了一项量子计算演示，实现了量子优势的基本标准：能够执行超出主流经典仿真方法能够达到的计算能力，同时保证计算结果准确。研究人员使用掺杂的克利福德采样和时空编码来认证经典硬量子计算，从而实现了迄今为止最大规模的逻辑量子计算演示之一。
来源：
https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-07-30-ibm-and-the-university-of-chicago-demonstrate-quantum-advantage,-establishing-trusted-quantum-computation-on-logical-circuits
电子科技大学
等研究
超导量子比特中动力学甜点的多目标优化工程设计
本研究提出了一个完全参数化的多目标周期通量调制框架，用于同时优化超导量子比特的能量弛豫时间
T₁和纯退相干时间T_φ，量化两者间的权衡。针对具有实际噪声谱的fluxonium量子比特，该方法在保持T₁达百微秒级的同时，将T_φ较现有动力学甜点策略提升了3至5倍。
研究
进一步证明，动力学甜点虽能消除对低频噪声的一阶敏感度，但弛豫率无法无限降低，从而确立了
T₁的上限。基于优化工作点，
研究
还设计了抑制泄漏的单、双量子比特门控协议，数值验证了高保真度操作。本研究为超导量子比特动力学甜点的帕累托前沿工程建立了一个通用框架，显著提升了相干时间和门性能。
研究成果于
7月25日发表于《
Communications Physics
》（通信物理）。
来源：
https://www.nature.com/articles/s42005-026-02778-2
美国杜克大学等在量子计算机上探测量子相变过程中的纠缠标度
本研究采用了多尺度纠缠重正化群拟设（
MERA），并在全连通离子阱量子计算机上实现了一种用于子系统层析成像的全息方案。该实验使用的方法能够仅用少量量子比特精确表示无限系统和长程关联，从而即使在临界点处也能高效提取可观测量和纠缠性质。研究
观测到
具有自发对称性破缺的量子相变，并揭示了纠缠性质随临界点的演化。研究首次在数字量子计算机上演示了临界点处子系统纠缠熵的对数标度律。这一成果凸显了
MERA在量子计算机上研究强关联多体系统方面的潜力。研究成果于7月27日发表于《Nature Communications》（自然·通讯）。
来源：
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-026-75251-x
中国科学技术大学
等进行光子波前与量子比特之间双向量子模数转换器实验
本
研究构建了一种双向量子模数转换器（

# Weekly Report | Largest Acquisition in Quantum Computing History: IonQ Pays $1.8 Billion for SkyWater; MIIT Establishes "Quantum Information Standardization Technical Committee"…

---

## IonQ Receives Regulatory Approval, Completes Acquisition of SkyWater Technology

On July 28, IonQ announced it had received final regulatory approval to acquire SkyWater Technology, with the two companies expecting to close the transaction by July 31, 2026, at a total deal value of approximately $1.8 billion. The acquisition strengthens IonQ's quantum computing manufacturing capabilities within the United States. The deal is intended to accelerate IonQ's quantum computing roadmap and establish a fully domestic, scalable semiconductor supply chain to support its chip-centric hardware strategy. Following the close, SkyWater will continue to operate under its existing name as a wholly owned subsidiary while continuing to serve foundry customers. The combined company plans to hold a Q2 earnings call on August 5, 2026, and an investor day on September 8, 2026.

Source: https://www.ionq.com/news/ionq-receives-regulatory-approval-to-complete-acquisition-of-skywater-technology

## Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Quantum Information Standardization Technical Committee Established

On July 30, the inaugural meeting of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) Quantum Information Standardization Technical Committee (量子信息标准化技术委员会) was held in Beijing. Ke Jixin, a member of the MIIT Party Committee and Vice Minister, attended and addressed the meeting. Officials from relevant MIIT departments, committee member representatives, and industry experts were also present. The committee is primarily responsible for drafting and revising industry standards in quantum information foundational and cross-cutting technologies, quantum computing, quantum communications, and quantum precision measurement. Its secretariat is located at the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT).

Source: https://www.miit.gov.cn/xwfb/bldhd/art/2026/art_79e6b8bde1974fc9b120b0e18cb0b262.html

## U.S. Senators Introduce National Quantum Readiness Act to Strengthen National Security and Innovation Through Quantum Technology

On July 28, U.S. Senators Mike Rounds and Richard Blumenthal introduced the National Quantum Readiness Act, legislation directing the Department of the Army to support the development of quantum technologies and promote private-sector innovation. The bill requires the Pentagon to designate three priority quantum sensor projects within 60 days and deploy them by September 30, 2028. It also calls for the development of relevant plans in collaboration with related agencies and private enterprises. One key area of focus is the potential accelerated adoption of post-quantum cryptography (后量子密码学) and its implications for encryption security.

Source: https://www.rounds.senate.gov/newsroom/press-releases/rounds-introduces-legislation-to-bolster-national-security-and-innovation-through-quantum-technologies

## Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center Receives $5 Million Grant to Build New Hybrid Quantum-Classical Supercomputer

On July 27, the Pittsburgh Supercomputing Center (PSC) received a $5 million grant from the National Science Foundation to build TangleLab — a hybrid quantum-classical supercomputing testbed developed in partnership with HPE and Rigetti Computing, expected to begin operations in 2027. TangleLab will integrate Rigetti Novera™ quantum processing units (QPUs) with HPE high-performance computing, storage, and networking systems to support research into hybrid quantum-classical workflows, artificial intelligence, simulation, and quantum computing applications. The system will provide competitive access, training, and technical support to researchers, educators, and students, advancing quantum computing research and workforce development while serving as a prototype for future hybrid network infrastructure.

Source: https://www.psc.edu/psc-will-build-new-hybrid-quantum-classical-supercomputer/

## AT&T Expands Partnership with D-Wave to Explore Quantum Computing Applications in Network Operations

On July 27, D-Wave and AT&T signed an agreement to expand the use of D-Wave's quantum computing technology in network optimization applications. AT&T has adopted D-Wave's annealing quantum computing (退火量子计算) technology, reducing processing time for optimization workloads from approximately one hour to under 15 seconds. The companies plan to explore additional applications including outage response, technician routing, network planning, traffic management, and potential quantum-safe use cases.

Source: https://www.dwavequantum.com/news/at-t-signs-agreement-to-expand-use-of-d-wave-s-quantum-computing-technology/

## QTREX Partners with Northeastern University to Launch Quantum Interconnect Research Program

On July 27, QTREX announced a research collaboration with Northeastern University to develop advanced cryogenic quantum interconnect technologies for quantum computing infrastructure. The collaboration will investigate microsystem architectures for cryogenic quantum environments, interconnect design, and materials suitable for low-temperature quantum operation, while generating experimental data to inform future connectivity solutions. Under the agreement, QTREX will receive the right of first negotiation to commercially license intellectual property generated through the joint research.

Source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/27/3333405/0/en/QTREX-Launches-Quantum-Interconnect-Research-Program-with-Commercialization-Rights-to-Project-Generated-IP.html

## Multiverse Computing Announces $570 Million Series C Financing Round to Accelerate CompactifAI Deployment

On July 27, Multiverse Computing announced it has raised a $570 million Series C financing round at a valuation of $1.7 billion, aimed at accelerating deployment of its AI model compression platform CompactifAI and scaling efficient AI infrastructure globally. The company's CompactifAI technology applies tensor network methods derived from quantum physics to compress large language models by 80–95% with minimal accuracy loss, enabling faster, lower-power AI deployment across cloud, on-premises, and edge environments. Funds will support R&D, sovereign AI infrastructure, expansion into key international markets, and scaled deployment across manufacturing, finance, energy, aerospace, cybersecurity, defense, and healthcare sectors.

EntangleX is a software-based quantum circuit simulator that uses classical computing infrastructure to simulate quantum circuits rather than running on physical quantum hardware.

The quarterly program will offer developer grants of $2,000–$4,000 to contributors focusing on areas such as error budgeting, threshold calculation, and benchmarking tools. On July 28, Infleqtion, Aliro, Tensora, and Bandelier Technologies joined ABQ-Net, a U.S.-based open-access entanglement-based quantum network headquartered in New Mexico, focused on developing and validating quantum networking, sensing, timing, and security technologies. ## ZuriQ Raises $25.5 Million Seed Round to Scale Pioneering 2D Quantum Architecture

On July 28, ZuriQ, a Swiss quantum computing company spun out of ETH Zurich (苏黎世联邦理工学院), announced it has raised $25.5 million in seed funding to scale its ion trap (离子阱) quantum processor. The round follows the company's $4.2 million pre-seed round in 2025 and was led by Quantonation, with participation from Forward.one, Extantia, Firgun Ventures, and all previous investors. On July 28, Anthropic reported that its Claude Mythos preview AI model discovered improved mathematical attacks against the HAWK post-quantum digital signature candidate and reduced-round AES, demonstrating that advanced AI can contribute to cryptography research without compromising existing production systems. The AI identified previously unknown mathematical symmetries to reduce HAWK's effective security margin, and developed a new attack that is 200–800 times faster than the research version on seven-round AES; researchers then spent several weeks verifying the model's results. Anthropic stated that these findings highlight AI's growing role in evaluating cryptographic algorithms prior to deployment, prompting the company to publish new research papers and release CryptanalysisBench to help researchers measure AI capabilities in cryptanalysis.

On July 29, EY announced it is expanding its global quantum computing capabilities by adding an on-site quantum computer as part of a more than $3 billion investment in AI and other emerging technologies. The new infrastructure is designed to support secure quantum application development and testing for use cases including optimization, fraud detection, data protection, and large-scale risk management.
